article.title: 小紅書為線上「小紅卡」招募雙11合作商戶
article.title_en: Xiaohongshu recruits Singles’ Day merchants for its online Little Red Card
article.summary: 據億邦動力，線上會員年費為人民幣66元，商戶可按商品報名提供會員專享價。
article.summary_en: EBRUN reports an annual membership fee of RMB 66 and a programme for merchants to offer member pricing on selected items.
highlights: 今次招商面向站內電商，與早前本地生活會員安排有別。
報名商品可按活動安排提供會員價。
highlights_en: The recruitment concerns online commerce and is distinct from the earlier local-services membership.
Enrolled products can offer member pricing under the campaign terms.
article.why: 品牌可把會員折扣當作獨立促銷方案，按商品毛利評估能否長期維持。
article.why_en: Brands can evaluate member discounts as a separate promotion against product margins.
article.next_step: 先挑一款商品，計算會員價與其他優惠疊加後的毛利及退貨成本。
article.next_step_en: Start with one product and estimate margin and returns after combining eligible discounts.
article.detail: 報道把本次安排描述為雙11商戶招商。參與商戶可依活動規則選擇商品，讓會員以專享價購買。品牌需要先確認價格折扣由誰承擔、哪些優惠可以疊加，以及售後成本如何入帳。會員開卡費用與品牌促銷成本宜分開計算，再以實際訂單和回購觀察成效。分析時宜記下各次活動的折扣條件。
article.detail_en: The report describes merchant recruitment for Singles’ Day. Participants can choose items and offer members a dedicated price under programme terms. Confirm who funds discounts, which offers can stack and how returns are handled. Separate membership fees from promotion costs, then assess orders and repeat purchases. Record the discount terms for each campaign.
